description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LDAPTestServiceAnonBindTest' that tests LDAP connection scenarios, specifically anonymous binding and handling of invalid host and port configurations within the context of the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin.

classes.name: LDAPTestServiceAnonBindTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing anonymous LDAP connection and invalid host/port scenarios.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup before any tests are run, checks LDAP server configuration.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test, ensures LDAP server is configured.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Configures LDAP server settings, enables anonymous binding, and loads test fixture data.

methods.name: testAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Verifies that an anonymous LDAP connection can be established successfully.

methods.name: testInvalidHost
methods.description: Tests connection failure when the LDAP host is invalid.

methods.name: testInvalidPort
methods.description: Tests connection failure when the LDAP port is invalid.

methods.name: testEncryptionWithPort
methods.description: Tests connection failure with SSL encryption on the default LDAP port.
